text_block_list.text: Heh… That is the plan, of course.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Though obstacles bar the path ahead… Though their thorns wound me as I walk…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It is a path worthy of the Overlord to travel. Thus, it is the Overlord's path!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let the gods see for themselves! My majesty does not yield in the face of hardship!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then I ask you this… Just what is strength?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: To me, it is the ability to march down your own path—to keep your legs churning no matter how many times you fall.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I will run, so that I may traverse the Overlord's path!
choice_data_list: For that is what it means to be the Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… Observe for yourself. My resurrection burns with the flames of a phoenix…
